hero_subhead: Burst pipe or boiler breakdown in Wolverhampton? We arrive fast and fix it right, day or night.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Wolverhampton
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full system installations, we handle all your plumbing and heating needs with speed and expertise.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast. We carry parts on the van and aim to have you sorted within the hour, 24/7.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Repair
services.desc: New boiler fitted with a 10-year warranty, or your current system repaired same day. We handle all makes and models.

services.title: Central Heating Maintenance
services.desc: Annual servicing keeps your system running efficiently and safely. We'll spot problems early and save you money on energy bills.

services.title: Radiator Installation & Balancing
services.desc: New radiators, towel rails, or full system upgrades. We balance your heating to ensure even warmth throughout your home.

services.title: Drain Unblocking
services.desc: Stubborn drains cleared quickly using modern equipment. Toilets, sinks, baths, and outdoor drains — we tackle them all.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: Full installation of new bathrooms and kitchens, from pipework to taps. We work to Building Regulations and leave your space immaculate.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I was tired of seeing customers ripped off by cowboys.
about_para_1: R S Heating Engineering was founded 18 years ago on a simple promise: honest prices, quality work, and a response time that actually matters. We've built our reputation across Wolverhampton and the Black Country by doing the job properly the first time, and by treating every customer's home the way we'd treat our own.
about_para_2: We're Gas Safe registered and fully insured. Our engineers arrive on time, in clean vans, with the parts they need to finish the job. Hundreds of Wolverhampton families call us back because we listen, we explain what we're doing, and we don't upsell unnecessary work. That's why 9 out of 10 customers recommend us to their neighbours.
reviews_heading: What Wolverhampton Families Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with a burst pipe on New Year's Eve. Called R S and they were round in 40 minutes. Fixed it properly, fair price, and didn't make a mess. Absolute lifesavers. Will use them again for sure.
reviews.author: David H.

reviews.text: Boiler packed in during the cold snap. R S got us a new one fitted the next morning. The lad explained everything, left the kitchen spotless, and the 10-year warranty gives me peace of mind. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Had the whole bathroom plumbed in. Professional crew, arrived when they said they would, finished on time. No drama, no hidden extras. That's rare. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: James P.
